summary: Completed backend and frontend E2E verification of Dispatch Reports, privileged-role restrictions, Dispatch Calendar, and regression routes against the public preview URL. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed, covering all five report endpoints, report/export RBAC, 92-day cap, financial aggregation/redaction, CSV/PDF payloads, and super-admin/HR role-assignment rules. Frontend: Calendar views/navigation/event dialog, all five report tabs, date refresh, CSV/PDF downloads, and four existing routes passed. Two minor accessibility/design issues remain.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening Schedule Details emits the Radix accessibility warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent.
Previous and Next are icon-only controls without accessible names (no aria-label), so screen readers cannot identify their purpose.

issues: Date From and Date To use native browser input[type='date'] controls rather than the app's shadcn calendar/date-picker pattern, resulting in browser-dependent presentation and behavior.

action_items: Add DialogDescription (or an explicit aria-describedby strategy) to ScheduleDetailDialog.
Add aria-labels to the Calendar previous/next icon buttons.
Replace native report date inputs with the shared shadcn date-picker/calendar component for consistent UX.
critical_code_review_comments: DispatchCalendarPage renders DialogContent without DialogDescription, directly causing the runtime accessibility warning reproduced during event-dialog testing.
The calendar view SelectItem controls do not have data-testid attributes even though they are interactive; tests had to fall back to accessible option roles.
The report filters explicitly use Input type='date', which invokes the browser-native picker rather than the project's component library.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional flows passed; 2 minor accessibility issues and 1 design consistency issue

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created isolated TEST_ Dispatch entities, current-date schedule, no-permission/view-only/redacted-report employees, HR/HD/super-admin/employee role fixtures, then deleted schedules and soft-deactivated entities/employees. Frontend created one temporary current-date Dispatch schedule with references and cleaned all of it through the API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Dedicated suite test_dispatch_reports_roles_iter17.py passes 13/13. The first UI run's final harness assertion saw expected navigation-aborted Cloudflare RUM/in-flight requests; every product flow passed, and a corrected retry passed with no runtime page errors or API 5xx. Functional exports and report/calendar behavior are verified.
rca_of_the_issue: ScheduleDetailDialog includes DialogContent, DialogHeader, and DialogTitle but no DialogDescription/aria-describedby, producing the Radix warning. Calendar prev/next buttons contain only SVG icons and lack aria-labels. DispatchReportsPage lines 136-137 explicitly render Input type='date', delegating the picker to the browser.
